 Jesse Yomtov Jon Arnold USA TODAY Updated Nov. 14, 2026, 9:29 p.m. ET Mexico manager Rafa Marquez wasn't able to get a win in his first four matches in charge, but there is little margin for error in his first official contest, the first leg of a Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal with Jamaica .
 The second leg is scheduled for Tuesday, Nov. 17 in Monterrey, Mexico. The aggregate winner advances to the semifinals of the tournament, which will played in March at SoFi Stadium in Southern California.
 Mexico won the 2025 Nations League, its first title after the United States took home the hardware in the first three editions. The Reggae Boyz reached this round by finishing second in Group B in qualifying with seven points.
 Follow for live updates: 
 Where to watch Mexico vs Jamaica: TV channel, streaming
 Time:  8 p.m. ET
 Channel/streaming:  Univision ( Watch LIVE on Fubo ), TUDN, ViX ( Watch on Prime Video )
 Watch Mexico-Jamaica on Fubo Mexico vs Jamaica live updates: 
 9:28 pm ET Share this update Gilberto Mora goal! Jamaica 3, Mexico 1
 18-year-old Gilberto Mora finally got Mexico on the scoreboard, scoring his second career international goal in the 70th minute in Kingston. That's a huge score for El Tri with the away goals rule in effect .
 9:20 pm ET Share this update 63': Richard King goal! JAM 3, MEX 0
 Richard King converts a penalty kick in the 63rd minute and the Reggae Boyz suddenly lead 3-0 in this two-legged Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal. Absolute disaster for Rafa Marquez's team.
 9:17 pm ET Share this update 60th minute: Jamaica 2, Mexico 0
 El Tri desperately need a goal – a road one, specifically – to get back in this tie. But Mexico hasn't managed a shot through 15 minutes in the second half.
 9:06 pm ET Share this update 46': Renaldo Cephas goal! Jamaica 2, Mexico 0
 It's an absolute nightmare for El Tri who concede a second goal less than a minute into the second half and are facing a long way back in this two-legged tie unless they turn this match around.
 8:50 pm ET Share this update Halftime: Jamaica 1, Mexico 0
 It's a surprise result through the first 45 minutes with Jamaica on top thanks to an own goal in the 27th minute. Mexico enjoyed 70% possession completed 251 passes (89% success rate) in the first half while Jamaica managed just 84 accurate passes.
 8:39 pm ET Share this update 35': Jamaica 1, Mexico 0
 Mexico has been pushing hard since conceding and have forced Jamaica goalkeeper Jahmali Waite into four saves through 35 minutes.
 8:31 pm ET Share this update 27': Jamaica scores! Jesus Gallardo own goal
 Jamaica takes a surprise 1-0 lead in the 27th minute on an own goal headed off Mexico's Jesus Gallardo on a corner kick.
 8:21 pm ET Share this update 20': Jahmali Waite keeps Jamaica-Mexico scoreless
 Twenty minutes into the match and neither team has been able to find a way through, with Mexico dominating possession. Jahmali Waite has had to make two saves for Jamaica already and it could be a long night.
 8:09 pm ET Share this update 10': Mexico dominating possession
 El Tri has enjoyed about 70% possession in the first 10 minutes of the match but have been unable to capitalize, managing just one shot – a speculative go from Gilberto Mora.
 8:06 pm ET Share this update Underway in Kingston
 Mexico and Jamaica have kicked off the first leg of this Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal.

 7:13 pm ET Share this update Jamaica vs. Mexico prediction, pick
 Mexico is clearly the more talented side but enters this first leg with pressure and tension after a bad start to the cycle. That pressure continues onto the second leg after a close opening 90 minutes.
 Prediction:  Jamaica 1, Mexico 1 
 – Rob Usry
